description.value: The Painted Turtle Restaurant is a seasonal full-service restaurant set within Dutch Lake Resort & RV Park in Clearwater, BC, about 1 km off the Yellowhead Highway near the gateway to Wells Gray Provincial Park. It holds the distinction of being the only open-air lakeside patio in Clearwater, with views directly over Dutch Lake — a memorable setting for cyclists travelling the Yellowhead corridor between Edmonton and Vancouver. The menu draws on local and regional ingredients, running from hearty breakfasts through dinner mains including fresh BC salmon and baby back ribs.
